title: dev-03: Model — Ingredient, Cookware, and Timer
description: Create Ingredient.swift, Cookware.swift, and Timer.swift with their public struct definitions. Each references Quantity? from dev-02. Add Sendable and Equatable conformances to all three.
acceptance_criteria: Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/Ingredient.swift declares public struct Ingredient: Sendable, Equatable with name: String, alias: String?, quantity: Quantity?, note: String?.
Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/Cookware.swift declares public struct Cookware: Sendable, Equatable with name: String and quantity: Quantity?.
Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/Timer.swift declares public struct Timer: Sendable, Equatable with name: String? and quantity: Quantity?.
